items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Can you, can you talk a little bit in your voice about what it is that keeps you intrigued in moving and risk-taking?

Well, yeah, I thought I had kinda talked about that quite a bit. But I have a low boredom threshold, evidently, and that’s… since it is quote “an art form”… and I prefer Jackson Pollock to… (laughs) I told you about that scene I had with our friend.
